test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Nati is a folk dance from which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nati** is a folk dance from the state of** Himachal Pradesh **in India.
 
• **It is a traditional dance form that is performed during various festivals and celebrations in the state.**
 
• The dance is performed in a **circle**
